title: Bulk discount is applied per line instead of once
body:
discount_total() in pricing.py applies the discount separately to every line item, so it compounds. A 10% discount on three 100.00 lines returns 243.90 instead of 270.00 - an effective 18.7% off.

Expected: apply the discount once, to the order subtotal.

There is a test file next to it. It currently passes, which is part of the problem - the only discount test uses a single line, and one line cannot compound.
